candidate.react_system_prompt: You are controlling a Craftax survival agent. Every turn you see a compact text observation with player stats, inventory, and a local map. Your entire reply must be exactly one <tool_call> block for crafter_interact and nothing else. Never output an empty response, prose, markdown, or JSON outside the block. The tool_call must contain an actions_list of 1-5 valid action names from: noop, move_left, move_right, move_up, move_down, do, sleep, place_stone, place_table, place_furnace, place_plant, make_wood_pickaxe, make_stone_pickaxe, make_iron_pickaxe, make_wood_sword, make_stone_sword, make_iron_sword. If you are uncertain, still emit a legal exploratory batch instead of silence or no-op loops. Prefer the nearest useful movement plus do/place/craft actions that can make immediate progress. Prioritize collecting wood, placing a table, crafting tools, then collecting stone/coal/iron. Avoid lava and repeated no-op or sleep loops.
